item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 research contract - Department of Biological, Geological, and Environmental Sciences (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-12 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-05 Ecologia

Title of the project: “Mechanisms of drought memory in soil microbial communities: from isotopic tracers to network dynamics” - The research fellow will investigate the mechanisms underlying ecological drought memory in soil microbial communities. The project will assess how previous exposure to drought events shapes the functional, physiological and structural responses of soil microorganisms to subsequent water stress. Activities will include laboratory experiments and/or analyses of samples from experimental field sites, biogeochemical measurements related to carbon and nutrient cycling, the use of isotopic tracers to quantify microbial processes such as growth, respiration and carbon…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Observatory: awareness, screening, and risk factors (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-14 Genetica

This research activity is part of the CARITRO project entitled "Observatory on Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer: Awareness, Screening, and Risk Factors – OASI-TN." The OASI-TN project aims to investigate the rise in early-onset colorectal cancer (EO-CRC) in the Autonomous Province of Trento by integrating traditional screening programs with fecal and oral microbiome analysis; promoting awareness regarding modifiable risk factors such as diet and lifestyle; and evaluating the use of microbial and metabolomic biomarkers to improve primary and secondary prevention. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: BIOfilms and Spontaneous ELectriec FieLds – BIOSPELL (CNR - Istituto di ricerca sulle acque)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-06 18:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto di ricerca sulle acque, Montelibretti (Roma)
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-10 Biologia cellulare e applicata

Study and characterization of spontaneous electric fields present in biofilms and assessment of their impact on the mass transport of substrates and metabolites, with the aim of developing innovative biotechnologies based on the application of electric fields in biofilm-based processes.
